STINT

The phone timer

The macOS panel's scope on a phone: the timer, Today and Earned, and five recent tasks to start again. No entry list, no project change while running. Data is the seeded account's (apps/web/src/mocks/fixtures.ts): Northwind's Rush: peak season fixes at $195 an hour. The app has no desktop layout; the width toggle is a large iPhone against a common Android width.
